p. 56; the work the article hangs this sentence on

explanation: The English article on the Sierra Leonean war gives the Liberian war as the source of both its sponsor and its manpower: the RUF began "with support from the special forces of Liberian dictator Charles Taylor, the National Patriotic Front of Liberia (NPFL)", and "As a result of the First Liberian Civil War, 80,000 refugees fled neighboring Liberia for the Sierra Leone – Liberian border... [they] helped provide the manpower for the RUF’s insurgency."
